ps.en: The rain began to [[pour]] on the second night of the flood, and by morning half the town's fields lay under water. Every family queued for its [[portion]] of relief grain, and the [[possibility]] of a second flood was no longer a remote one. Mayor Chen walked the shelter rows herself, stopping to [[console]] every family that had lost a home. The [[potential]] for disease, the doctors warned, was real.
ps.zh: 洪灾第二夜，雨开始倾盆而下，到清晨，全镇一半的田地已泡在水里。每家每户排队领取一份救济粮，第二次洪峰的可能性已不再遥远。陈镇长亲自走遍安置点的每一排，停下来安慰每一个失去家园的家庭。医生警告说，爆发疫病的潜在风险是真实存在的。

ps.en: On the tenth day the council voted to [[constitute]] a reconstruction committee of seven — one delegate from each [[constituent]] district — and gave it one year to draft a town [[constitution]]. The document would [[consist]] of twelve clauses: budgets must be [[consistent]] with the relief plan, audits must be [[constant]], and no emergency decree could [[constrain]] the press. It was [[possible]], Chen admitted, that they would fail. But a town, she said, is not rebuilt with tents; it is rebuilt with rules.
ps.zh: 第十天，镇议会表决成立一个七人重建委员会——每个构成选区派出一名代表——并给它一年时间起草一部镇宪章。文件将包含十二条条款：预算必须与赈灾方案保持一致，审计必须常态化，任何紧急法令都不得限制新闻界。陈承认，失败是可能的。但她说，重建一座城镇靠的不是帐篷，而是规则。

ps.en: Before the vote, the committee had to [[construct]] a drainage system out of almost nothing, and to draw a hard [[distinction]] between emergency powers and ordinary ones. The difference between the old administration and the new one was [[distinct]] to every reader of the charter. When the constitution passed, 214 to 9, Chen did not smile. She was already looking at the river.
ps.zh: 表决之前，委员会几乎白手起家建造了一套排水系统，并在紧急权力与常规权力之间划出一道分明的界限。新旧两届政府之间的差别，每一个读过宪章的人都看得清清楚楚。宪章以二百一十四票对九票通过时，陈没有笑。她已经在望着那条河了。

ps.en: For four years Gao cut trailers at Aurora, an [[entertainment]] [[enterprise]] that had grown into a [[monopoly]] without anyone quite noticing. Her own job was [[monotonous]] — the same three-second transitions, the same hollow music — and the [[environment]] on the ninth floor discouraged questions. The company's official [[function]], according to its annual letter, was to [[entertain]] two hundred million people. Its real function, Gao suspected, was to keep them from counting.
ps.zh: 四年里，高在极光公司剪预告片——这是一家娱乐企业，不知不觉间已长成垄断巨头。她自己的工作单调乏味——同样的三秒转场、同样空洞的音乐——而九楼的工作环境不鼓励提问。按年度公开信的说法，公司的官方职能是娱乐两亿人。高怀疑，它真正的职能是让人不去计较。

ps.en: The [[evidence]] arrived by accident: a backup drive left in a drawer. It took her three months to [[distinguish]] the genuine viewing figures from the ones the sales team had invented, and the pattern, once seen, was [[evident]] — fake numbers were used to [[fund]] new acquisitions. Her lawyer called it fraud; her mother called it courage. Gao called it the [[fundamental]] lie at the heart of every confident chart.
ps.zh: 证据是偶然出现的：一个被遗忘在抽屉里的备份硬盘。她花了三个月，才把真实的观看数据从销售团队编造的数字中辨别出来；而一旦看清，模式便显而易见——假数字被用来为新的收购提供资金。律师管这叫欺诈；母亲管这叫勇气。高说，这是每一张自信图表背后最根本的谎言。

ps.en: The lawsuit would [[frustrate]] the company's expansion for years, and no settlement could [[fulfill]] what the shareholders had been promised. In the end Gao refused to call the company [[evil]] — evil, she said, requires intent, and what she had found was only greed wearing a smile. Her patience proved [[fruitful]]: the monopoly was broken into three. She spent the bonus on a small garden, and has not opened the streaming app since.
ps.zh: 这场诉讼会让公司的扩张受挫多年，而任何和解方案都无法兑现股东曾被许诺的一切。最终，高拒绝把这家公司称为邪恶——她说，邪恶需要主观恶意，而她发现的只是戴着微笑的贪婪。她的耐心有了回报：垄断企业被拆成三家。她用奖金买了一个小花园，此后再也没有打开过那个流媒体应用。

ps.en: The [[mood]] in Ward 6 changed the day Dr. Luo announced the organ-sharing network. Until then, a successful [[transplant]] had depended on luck: a donor in one city, a recipient in another, a helicopter that might or might not [[transport]] the organ in time. The new system would [[transmit]] the donor's data to every matching hospital within seconds — a [[transmission]] that once took four phone calls and a prayer.
ps.zh: 罗医生宣布器官共享网络的那一天，六病区的气氛变了。在此之前，一例成功的移植全靠运气：供体在一座城市，受者在另一座，直升机未必能把器官及时运达。新系统会在几秒钟内把供体数据传送给每一家配型医院——而这样的信息传递，过去需要四通电话加一次祈祷。

ps.en: Building it was harder. Luo had to [[store]] donor records across three provinces, keep a cold [[storage]] chain unbroken, and [[stock]] every node with surgical teams on rotation. The [[structure]] of the network survived its first test by accident — a storm [[struck|strike]] on launch night, knocking out power in two cities, and yet the organs arrived. 'Luck,' the engineers said. Luo said nothing and checked the logs.
ps.zh: 搭建它要难得多。罗必须在三个省份储存供体档案，保持低温储藏链不断链，还要给每个节点配备轮班的手术团队。网络体系第一次经受考验纯属意外——上线当夜一场风暴来袭，两座城市停电，器官却照样送达。工程师们说：「运气。」罗什么也没说，去查了日志。

ps.en: Within a year the program took a great [[stride]] forward: waiting lists shortened by a fifth, and the results were so [[striking]] that sceptics were [[stunned|stun]] into silence. The [[primary]] obstacle was no longer technology but money; the [[prime]] concern, Luo told the ministry, was to keep the network public. Behind him, a [[string]] of red dots lit up the map — one for every organ on its way to a stranger.
ps.zh: 一年之内，这个项目大踏步前进：等候名单缩短了五分之一，成果之显著，让怀疑者震惊得哑口无言。首要障碍不再是技术而是钱；罗对部里说，最要紧的问题是保住网络的公共属性。他身后的屏幕上，一连串红点照亮了地图——每一个红点，都是一颗正在送往陌生人那里的器官。

ps.en: For eleven years the file of Ma Dezhong, an [[innocent]] man serving a life sentence, gathered dust in the appeals court. His mother mailed an [[annual]] letter to three newspapers, and a night-shift [[anchor]] at the local station kept reading it aloud. The family's [[anguish]] slowly turned into background noise — an open file that seemed to [[annoy]] no one in particular.
ps.zh: 十一年来，马德忠的案卷在上诉法院积灰——这个无辜的人正在服无期徒刑。他的母亲每年给三家报纸寄一封信，当地电视台一名夜班主持人总把它念出来。这家人的极度痛苦渐渐成了背景音——一份敞开的卷宗，似乎并不特别惹恼任何人。

ps.en: The turn came from an [[innovation]] no one had planned around: old interrogation tapes, re-examined. A professor of [[psychology]] testified that the confession had been extracted by methods [[primitive]] even for 2003, and a specialist in [[psychiatry]] described the cell where Ma had spent two years in solitary. The [[principal]] witness had recanted in 2019; the [[principle]] at stake, the defence argued, was older than any statute — the state must prove, not presume.
ps.zh: 转机来自一项没人料到的革新：重新审查当年的审讯录音。一位心理学教授作证说，那份口供是用即便放到2003年也属原始的方法逼出来的；一位精神病学专家描述了马德忠独居两年的牢房。主要证人早在2019年就翻供了；辩方说，此案牵涉的原则比任何法条都古老——国家必须证明，而不能推定。

ps.en: The court found the province [[liable]] and ordered compensation, though no sum could discharge a [[liability]] measured in eleven years. The laboratory that had handled the original samples lost its [[license]] that same month. The judge, a [[liberal]] appointed the previous spring, read the ruling without looking up; at four in the afternoon the gates opened, and by evening the headlines announced that Ma Dezhong had been [[liberated|liberate]]. The night-shift anchor read the verdict twice, slowly, in case anyone had missed it the first time.
ps.zh: 法院裁定省里负有法律责任并判令赔偿，尽管没有一笔钱能清偿以十一年计的责任。那个最初经办样本的实验室同月失去了执照。那位前一年春天上任的开明法官宣读裁决时头也不抬；下午四点，大门打开，到傍晚，头条已宣布马德忠获释。夜班主持人把判决书念了两遍，很慢，生怕有人第一遍没听清。

c: a portion of 一部分；一份
divide sth into portions 把…分成若干份
a generous portion 一大份
fam: portion v. 分配（与名词同形）
words.dif: portion 强调「从整体中分出的一份」，常接 of；part 是最通用的「部分」，无分份意味
words.pat: The first portion of any budget should go to the people it is meant to serve.
words.patZh: 任何预算的第一份，都应花在它本该服务的人身上。

words.exam: 可能；可能性；可能的事；希望
c: the possibility of doing sth 做某事的可能性
a real / distinct possibility 现实的可能性
raise the possibility of 提出…的可能
within the bounds of possibility 在可能的范围内
fam: possible adj. → possibly adv. → possibility n.
words.dif: possibility 只是「可能存在」，不含概率大小；probability 才强调「概率」，可能性更大
words.pat: Every reform begins with the possibility that things could be otherwise.
words.patZh: 每一项改革，都始于「事情本可以是另一个样子」的可能性。

c: as soon as possible 尽快
it is possible that... 有可能…
do everything possible 尽一切可能
if possible 如果可能的话
words.dif: possible 只陈述「可能发生」；probable 表示「很可能发生」，语气更强
words.pat: It is possible to respect a decision while still questioning the process behind it.
words.patZh: 尊重一个决定，同时质疑它背后的程序，这两件事可以并存。

words.exam: 可能性；潜力；潜能；潜在的；可能的
c: the potential for sth …的潜在可能
reach one's full potential 充分发挥潜能
a potential customer 潜在客户
have the potential to do 有做…的潜力
words.dif: potential 作名词指「尚未兑现的潜能」，作形容词指「潜在的」；possible 只表「可能」，不强调「蕴含力量」
words.pat: Every crisis carries the potential for change, but never the guarantee of it.
words.patZh: 每一场危机都蕴含变革的可能，却从不保证变革必然到来。

c: pour sth into 把…倒入
pour down 倾盆而下
pour money into 向…大笔投入资金
pour out 倾诉；涌出
words.dif: pour 强调「大量、快速地倾注」，可指液体、金钱、人群；flow 只强调「持续流动」，不含量多
words.pat: Public money should be poured into schools before it is poured into stadiums.
words.patZh: 公共资金该先倾注于学校，再谈倾注于体育馆。

c: console sb for sth 因某事安慰某人
console oneself with 以…自我宽慰
a games console 游戏机
words.dif: console 是「让痛苦者好受一些」，对象多为他人；comfort 兼指「身体上的舒适」，词义更宽
words.pat: Statistics cannot console a family; only the truth, spoken plainly, can.
words.patZh: 数字安慰不了一个家庭；只有Plainly说出的真相可以。

c: consist of 由…组成
consist in 在于，存在于
consist with 与…一致
words.dif: consist of 表「由…构成」（整体在前）；consist in 表「在于」（本质在前）；consist with 现已罕用，多用 be consistent with
words.pat: Good governance consists of rules that bind the rulers as well as the ruled.
words.patZh: 良治在于一套既约束被治理者、也约束治理者自身的规则。

words.exam: 始终如一的；连续的；持续的；与…一致的
c: be consistent with 与…一致
a consistent policy 一以贯之的政策
consistent growth 持续的增长
remain consistent 保持前后一致
fam: consist vi. → consistency n. → consistently adv.
words.dif: consistent 强调「前后一致、不自相矛盾」；constant 强调「持续不变」。两者常同时出现在选项中
words.pat: A consistent policy is worth more than a brilliant one that changes every year.
words.patZh: 一项前后一致的政策，胜过一项年年变动的聪明政策。

c: constant pressure 持续的压力
at a constant speed 以恒定的速度
constant exposure to 长期暴露在…
a constant companion 忠实的伙伴
words.dif: constant 强调「稳定、不变、持续」；continual 强调「一再重复」，常含厌烦意味
words.pat: Trust is the constant audit that no institution can outsource.
words.patZh: 信任是一场常态化的审计，任何机构都外包不了。

words.exam: 构成的；组成的；成分；选民
c: a constituent part 组成部分
the constituents of …的选民
constituent assembly 制宪会议
words.dif: constituent 作名词兼「成分」与「选民」两义；constitution 是「宪法」，词形相近义更远
words.pat: A representative who ignores his constituents will soon have none left to represent.
words.patZh: 一个无视选民的代表，很快就没有人可代表了。

c: constitute a committee 成立委员会
constitute a threat to 对…构成威胁
constitute 80% of 占…的八成
words.dif: constitute 是「整体由部分构成」的正式说法（Seven members constitute the committee）；consist of 则倒装（The committee consists of seven members）
words.pat: Seven people with a shared rule can constitute a government; one person with an army can only imitate one.
words.patZh: 七个人守着共同的规则可以成立一个政府；一个人带着军队，只能模仿一个政府。

c: draft a constitution 起草宪法
amend the constitution 修宪
a written constitution 成文宪法
a strong constitution 强健的体格
fam: constitute v. → constitutional adj. → constitutionally adv.
words.dif: constitution 兼「宪法」「构造」「体质」三义；charter 只指「特许状、章程」，无法律根本法地位
words.pat: A constitution is not what a nation says on paper but what it does on its worst day.
words.patZh: 宪法不是一个民族纸面上写了什么，而是它在最糟的那一天做了什么。

c: constrain sb to do sth 迫使某人做某事
be constrained by 受…的约束
constrain spending 压缩开支
feel constrained to 感到不得不
fam: constraint n. 约束；限制因素
words.dif: constrain 强调「外力约束、迫使」，可接 sb to do；restrain 强调「自我克制」（restrain oneself），一般不接 to do
words.pat: A free press is constrained by facts, not by decrees.
words.patZh: 自由的新闻界受事实约束，而不受法令约束。

c: construct a bridge 架桥
construct an argument 构建论点
a theoretical construct 理论构想
be constructed from 由…建成
words.dif: construct 的名词是 construction，注意与 contrast（对比）只差一两个字母，形近易混
words.pat: It is easier to construct a new system than to repair trust in an old one.
words.patZh: 搭建一个新体系，比修复对一个旧体系的信任要容易。

c: be distinct from 与…截然不同
a distinct possibility 现实的可能
a distinct advantage 明显的优势
in distinct categories 界限分明的类别
words.dif: distinct 强调「可以清楚区分开」；distinctive 强调「有独特风格的」。a distinct smell 是「明显的气味」，a distinctive smell 是「标志性的气味」
words.pat: There is a distinct difference between refusing to answer and having nothing to say.
words.patZh: 拒绝回答与无话可说，是截然不同的两件事。

c: draw a distinction between 在…之间划清界限
make no distinction 一视同仁
a writer of distinction 杰出的作家
with distinction 以优异成绩
fam: distinct adj. → distinction n. → distinctive adj.
words.dif: distinction 兼「差别」与「卓越」两义；difference 只有「差别」一义
words.pat: The law must draw a distinction between error and deceit, or punish both as if they were the same.
words.patZh: 法律必须在错误与欺骗之间划出界限，否则便会把两者混为一谈一并惩罚。

c: distinguish A from B 区分 A 与 B
distinguish between right and wrong 明辨是非
distinguish oneself 使自己出名
distinguish fact from opinion 区分事实与观点
words.dif: distinguish 是中性词「辨别」；discriminate 除「辨别」外还常指「歧视」，语境敏感
words.pat: The first skill of a scientist is to distinguish what is known from what is merely believed.
words.patZh: 科学家的第一项本领，是分清「已知」与「只是相信」。

c: a fruitful discussion 富有成果的会谈
prove fruitful 证明有成效
a fruitful collaboration 成果丰硕的合作
fam: fruit n. → fruitful adj. → fruitless adj. 无果的，徒劳的
words.dif: fruitful 强调「有实际成果」；productive 强调「产量高、产出多」，可指工厂也可指土地
words.pat: Patience is rarely written into business plans, yet it is often the most fruitful investment.
words.patZh: 耐心很少被写进商业计划书，却往往是最有回报的投资。

c: frustrate the plan 使计划受挫
be frustrated by 因…而沮丧
frustrate an attempt 挫败一次企图
feel frustrated 感到灰心
words.dif: frustrate 指使「努力落空」或「人心灰意冷」；prevent 只指「阻止发生」，不含情绪
words.pat: Every rule that cannot be enforced frustrates the ones who try to obey it.
words.patZh: 每一条无法执行的规则，挫伤的恰恰是那些试图遵守它的人。

c: fulfill a promise 兑现承诺
fulfill one's duty 履行职责
fulfill a contract 履行合同
fulfill the requirements 满足要求
words.dif: fulfill 后接 promise / duty / potential 等抽象宾语；finish 只接具体任务（finish the work）
words.pat: A company that cannot fulfill its promises to employees will not keep its customers for long.
words.patZh: 连对员工的承诺都兑现不了的公司，留不住多久的客户。

words.exam: 功能；作用；职责；运行；起作用
c: the function of …的功能
fulfill a function 履行职能
function as 起…的作用
a social function 社交宴会
fam: functional adj. 功能的；实用的
words.dif: function as 表「充当、起…作用」（The sofa functions as a bed）；function 作「宴会」是正式义项，阅读中常见
words.pat: The real function of a headline is not to inform but to decide what deserves attention.
words.patZh: 标题真正的职能不是提供信息，而是决定什么值得关注。

words.exam: 资金；基金；为…提供资金；资助
c: raise funds 筹款
a pension fund 养老基金
public funds 公共资金
fund a project 资助一个项目
words.dif: fund 作动词是「出资、资助」；found 是「创立（组织）」，只差一个字母，形近易混
words.pat: Whoever funds the research owns its questions, if not always its answers.
words.patZh: 谁资助研究，谁就拥有它的问题——哪怕不一定拥有它的答案。

words.exam: 基础的；根本的；十分重大的
c: a fundamental change 根本性的变化
a fundamental right 基本权利
the fundamentals of …的基本原理
be fundamental to 对…至关重要
words.dif: fundamental 强调「根基性的、牵一发动全身」；basic 只指「基础的、初级的」，语气弱得多
words.pat: The most fundamental question in economics is still who gets to decide what is produced.
words.patZh: 经济学最根本的问题，仍然是：由谁来决定生产什么。

c: evidence of / for …的证据
give evidence 作证
in evidence 明显地；在作证
a piece of evidence 一条证据
words.dif: evidence 是不可数名词，不说 an evidence；proof 可数，可指抽象或具体的「证明」
words.pat: Evidence does not speak for itself; someone must decide which of it gets heard.
words.patZh: 证据不会自己说话；总得有人决定哪些证据可以被听见。

c: it is evident that... 显而易见…
be evident from 从…中可以看出
become increasingly evident 越来越明显
fam: evidence n. → evident adj. → evidently adv.
words.dif: evident 是正式用词「明显可辨」；obvious 更口语化，且含「本应看出」的意味
words.pat: It is evident from the data that the policy helped most those who needed it least.
words.patZh: 数据清楚显示：这项政策最能惠及的人，恰恰是需求最小的那批。

words.exam: 邪恶的；罪恶的；邪恶；罪恶
c: the root of all evil 万恶之源
evil consequences 恶果
do evil 作恶
a necessary evil 难免的坏事
words.dif: evil 指道德上的「恶」，程度深；bad 只是「不好」。necessary evil 是固定搭配，指「不得已而为之的坏事」
words.pat: The most durable evils are rarely committed by villains, but by ordinary people following instructions.
words.patZh: 最持久的恶行，很少出自反派之手，而是出自照章办事的普通人。

c: protect the environment 保护环境
a working environment 工作环境
the business environment 商业环境
damage to the environment 对环境的破坏
words.dif: environment 兼指「自然环境」与「抽象环境」（工作环境、商业环境）；surroundings 只指具体的「周遭事物」
words.pat: A competitive environment forces companies to improve; a protected one teaches them to complain.
words.patZh: 竞争的环境逼企业进步；受保护的环境只会教它们抱怨。

c: a state-owned enterprise 国有企业
private enterprise 私营企业
a joint enterprise 共同事业
spirit of enterprise 进取精神
words.dif: enterprise 兼指「企业」「事业」「进取心」；entrepreneur 只指「创业者、企业家」，注意词形区分
words.pat: Every great enterprise begins as an arrangement that reasonable people advised against.
words.patZh: 每一项伟大的事业，起初都是明理之人劝你别做的安排。

c: entertain guests 招待客人
entertain the audience 娱乐观众
entertain an idea 怀有（想法）
entertain sb to dinner 宴请某人
words.dif: entertain 除「娱乐」外还有僻义「怀有、考虑」（entertain a doubt）；amuse 只指「逗乐」
words.pat: A show that only entertains is forgotten by morning; one that also asks questions lingers for years.
words.patZh: 只图娱乐的节目，天亮即被遗忘；顺带提问的节目，能让人记很多年。

c: the entertainment industry 娱乐产业
provide entertainment 提供娱乐
a form of entertainment 一种娱乐形式
entertainment value 娱乐价值
fam: entertain v. → entertainment n. → entertainer n.
words.dif: entertainment 是「娱乐这一活动或行业」；amusement 侧重「被逗乐的那一瞬间」
words.pat: When entertainment becomes an industry, attention becomes its raw material and boredom its waste.
words.patZh: 当娱乐成为产业，注意力就是它的原料，无聊就是它的废料。

words.exam: 垄断；专利（品）；垄断者（企业）
c: have a monopoly of / on 垄断…
break up a monopoly 拆分垄断
a state monopoly 国家专营
grant a monopoly 授予专营权
words.dif: monopoly 是「市场垄断」；monotony 是「单调」，同词根 mono- 但词义领域完全不同
words.pat: A monopoly on information is the only monopoly that never admits it is one.
words.patZh: 对信息的垄断，是唯一从不承认自己是垄断的垄断。

words.exam: 单调无聊的；毫无变化的
c: a monotonous job 单调的工作
a monotonous voice 平淡无奇的嗓音
monotonous routine 一成不变的日常
words.dif: monotonous 强调「无变化的重复」；tedious 强调「冗长得让人厌烦」，未必重复
words.pat: Work that is monotonous is not always worthless; rivers carve canyons by repeating themselves.
words.patZh: 单调的工作未必无价值——河流正是靠重复自己，才切出了峡谷。

c: in a good / bad mood 心情好、坏
in the mood for 有心情做…
the mood of the room 房间里的气氛
lift one's mood 提振情绪
words.dif: mood 指「个人心情」或「场所氛围」；mode 是「模式」，形近义异
words.pat: The mood of a workplace is set less by its walls than by what happens when someone makes a mistake.
words.patZh: 一个工作场所的气氛，更多取决于有人犯错时会发生什么，而不是它的装修。

c: data transmission 数据传输
the transmission of disease 疾病的传播
a live transmission 现场直播
interrupt the transmission 中断传送
words.dif: transmission 是 transmit 的名词，兼指「传送」与「传染」；transfer 侧重「移交、调动」，对象多为权利或人员
words.pat: The speed of transmission is not the same as the speed of understanding.
words.patZh: 传递的速度，不等于理解的速度。

c: transmit data 传输数据
transmit a signal 发射信号
transmit disease 传播疾病
be transmitted from... to... 从…传向…
words.dif: transmit 强调「从一点发送到另一点」，可指信号、数据或疾病；transfer 强调「位置或所有权的转移」
words.pat: A network can transmit a message in seconds, but it cannot transmit the weight of a hand on a shoulder.
words.patZh: 网络可以在几秒内传送一条消息，却传送不了搭在肩头那只手的分量。

c: a heart transplant 心脏移植
transplant an organ 移植器官
a transplanted community 迁入的社群
reject a transplant 排异移植物
words.dif: transplant 指「连根移走再种下」，可指器官、植物或人；transfer 只指「转移」，不含「重新扎根」
words.pat: A successful transplant saves one life; a successful system saves the next hundred.
words.patZh: 一次成功的移植救一个人，一套成功的系统救之后的一百个。

words.exam: 运输；运输系统；运载工具
c: transport goods 运输货物
public transport 公共交通
means of transport 交通工具
transport sth from A to B 把…从 A 运到 B
fam: transportation n. 运输（美式常用）
words.dif: transport 泛指「运送」；traffic 指「交通（流量）」，不指运输行为本身
words.pat: Cheap transport shrinks the world; reliable transport shrinks it fairly.
words.patZh: 廉价的运输让世界变小，可靠的运输让世界公平地变小。

c: in stock 有货
out of stock 缺货
stock up on 囤积
stocks and shares 股票
words.dif: stock 兼指「库存」与「股票」；store 指「储存的行为或场所」。in stock 是购物高频搭配
words.pat: A hospital that cannot stock the basics has no business buying the latest machine.
words.patZh: 连基本物资都储备不了的医院，没资格买最新的设备。

c: a grocery store 杂货店
store information 储存信息
in store 储备着；（尤指）即将发生
a store of knowledge 知识的积累
words.dif: in store 是高频短语，表「即将降临」（Who knows what is in store for us?）；与 in the store（在店里）完全不同
words.pat: Data that is cheap to store is expensive to protect.
words.patZh: 储存起来很便宜的数据，保护起来很贵。

c: data storage 数据存储
cold storage 冷藏
storage capacity 存储容量
in storage 在保管中
words.dif: storage 是「储存的行为、能力或场所」；store 作名词多指「商店」或「贮备物」
words.pat: The cold storage of a single organ can decide whether a waiting list gets shorter or longer.
words.patZh: 一颗器官在冷藏链里的几小时，可以决定一张等候名单变短还是变长。

c: make great strides 取得巨大进步
stride forward 大步向前
take sth in one's stride 从容应对
with long strides 迈着大步
fam: 不规则变化：stride - strode - stridden n. 相关延伸
words.dif: stride 的引申义「进展」只用复数 strides（make great strides）；不可说 make a great stride in this sense
words.pat: A society makes its fastest strides not when it is comfortable but when it is slightly afraid.
words.patZh: 一个社会进步最快的时刻，不是它安逸的时候，而是它略有畏惧的时候。

words.exam: 给…以（深刻）印象；突然想到；罢工；打；击
c: strike a balance 取得平衡
it strikes sb that... 某人突然想到
be struck by 被…打动
go on strike 罢工
fam: struck 过去式 / 过去分词 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: strike 作「突然想到」用 it strikes sb that...，主语是事物不是人；「罢工」与「打击」是同形异源义
words.pat: It strikes most people only in retrospect how much of their luck was actually someone's design.
words.patZh: 人们多半要在事后才突然想到：自己多少「运气」，其实是别人有意的设计。

c: a striking difference 显著的差异
a striking example 引人注目的例子
bear a striking resemblance to 与…极为相似
a striking figure 惹人注目的人物
fam: strike v. → striking adj. → strikingly adv.
words.dif: striking 是形容词「显著的」；strikingly 是副词；不要在需要副词的位置漏掉 -ly
words.pat: The most striking feature of the reform was not what it changed but what it refused to change.
words.patZh: 这场改革最显著之处，不是它改了什么，而是它拒绝改什么。

c: a string of 一连串
pull strings 暗中操纵
no strings attached 无附加条件
string together 把…串起来
fam: stringent adj. 严格的（形近但不同源）
words.dif: string 的复数是 strings；a string of 后接复数名词，谓语动词用单数（A string of accidents was reported）
words.pat: Every scandal begins as a string of small decisions, each of which looked reasonable at the time.
words.patZh: 每一场丑闻，都始于一连串小决定——每一个在当时都显得合理。

c: social structure 社会结构
the structure of an essay 文章的结构
a fee structure 收费体系
structure one's day 规划自己的一天
words.dif: structure 兼作动词「使成体系」；infrastructure 是「基础设施」，二者是整体与部分的关系
words.pat: A problem that survives every reorganization was never a problem of structure.
words.patZh: 一个经历每次重组都原样存活的问题，从来就不是结构问题。

c: be stunned by 被…惊呆了
stun the audience 令观众震撼
a stunning reversal 惊人的逆转
stun sb into silence 惊得某人哑口无言
fam: stunning adj. 极美的；惊人的
words.dif: stun 的派生 stunning 褒义多于贬义（a stunning view）；shocking 多含负面意味
words.pat: The figures stunned the committee into a silence that lasted the rest of the afternoon.
words.patZh: 那组数字惊得委员会哑口无言，沉默一直持续到下午散会。

c: the primary cause 首要原因
primary school 小学
a primary concern 首要关切
primary elections 初选
words.dif: primary 强调「第一位的、首要的」；primitive 强调「原始的、简陋的」。形近义差大
words.pat: The primary task of statistics is not to impress but to prevent self-deception.
words.patZh: 统计学的首要任务不是唬人，而是防止自欺。

words.exam: 首要的；基本的；壮年；全盛时期；把…准备好
c: prime minister 首相
in the prime of life 正值壮年
prime time 黄金时段
prime the pump 刺激经济
words.dif: prime 作名词指「黄金时期」；primary 没有此义。prime suspect 指「头号嫌疑人」，是新闻高频搭配
words.pat: In the prime of its power, an institution is most tempted to mistake luck for design.
words.patZh: 一个机构在权力的全盛时期，最容易把运气误认为设计。

c: primitive tools 原始工具
primitive methods 简陋的方法
a primitive society 原始社会
primitive instincts 原始本能
words.dif: primitive 强调「原始、简陋」，含贬义；primary 强调「首要」，是中性词
words.pat: Methods that were primitive a decade ago are now simply called negligence.
words.patZh: 十年前算是简陋的做法，如今只配叫失职。

c: the principal reason 主要原因
a school principal 校长
principal and interest 本金与利息
the principal of a firm 事务所的委托人
words.dif: principal 与 principle 只差结尾：-pal 是「校长、本金、主要的」，-ple 是「原则」。记法：your principal is your pal
words.pat: The principal obstacle to reform is usually the last reform, badly done.
words.patZh: 改革最主要的障碍，往往是上一场没搞好的改革。

c: in principle 原则上
on principle 出于原则
stick to one's principles 坚持原则
the principles of physics 物理学原理
words.dif: in principle 表「原则上同意（细节未定）」；in practice 表「实际上」，两者常成对出现
words.pat: A principle that bends under pressure was never a principle, only a preference.
words.patZh: 一受压就弯的原则，从来不是原则，只是偏好。

words.exam: 精神病学；精神病治疗法
c: a professor of psychiatry 精神病学教授
forensic psychiatry 司法精神病学
a psychiatry ward 精神科病房
words.dif: psychiatry 是「精神病学」（医学分支）；psychology 是「心理学」，前者可以开药，后者一般不能
words.pat: Advances in psychiatry have taught courts to ask not only what the defendant did but what his mind could not do.
words.patZh: 精神病学的进步，让法庭不只问被告做了什么，也问他的心智做不到什么。

c: social psychology 社会心理学
the psychology of crowds 群体心理
educational psychology 教育心理学
words.dif: psychology 是「心理学」（学科）；physiology 是「生理学」，形近而领域不同
words.pat: Understanding the psychology of a committee is often more useful than mastering its agenda.
words.patZh: 读懂一个委员会的心理，往往比熟记它的议程更有用。

c: legal liability 法律责任
liability to do sth 有做…的倾向
limited liability 有限责任
assets and liabilities 资产与负债
words.dif: liability 兼指「法律责任」「负债」「累赘」与「倾向」，是 liability to 后接不定式；asset（资产）的反义词
words.pat: Every new convenience creates a liability that its designers never planned to insure.
words.patZh: 每一项新便利，都制造出其设计者从未打算投保的责任。

words.exam: 负有（法律）责任的；有…倾向的；可能遭受…的
c: be liable for 对…负有法律责任
be liable to do 易于做…
be liable to sth 可能遭受…
hold sb liable 认定某人有责任
words.dif: liable for 表「对…担责」（法律义）；liable to do 表「容易做…」（倾向义）。介词不同，含义天差地别
words.pat: Publishers were once liable for every claim they printed; the internet forgot that lesson within a decade.
words.patZh: 出版商曾经要为刊出的每一句话担责；而互联网在十年内就忘掉了这一课。

words.exam: （政治或经济上）自由的；支持（社会、政治）变革的；开明的
c: a liberal interpretation 从宽的解释
liberal arts 文科
be liberal with 对…出手大方
liberal policies 自由派政策
words.dif: liberal 在美语中指「自由派（偏左）」，在 general English 中指「开明的、慷慨的」；liberty 是其名词「自由」
words.pat: A liberal education does not teach you what to think; it teaches you how to notice what you are thinking.
words.patZh: 通识教育不教你想什么，它教你觉察自己正在想什么。

c: liberate sb from sth 把某人从…中解放出来
liberate a city 解放一座城市
liberate the mind 解放思想
words.dif: liberate 是「把人从压迫中解放出来」，宾语多为人；release 是「放行、释放」，对象可以是物
words.pat: A verdict can liberate a man in the afternoon; it takes a society much longer to liberate its habits.
words.patZh: 一份判决可以在下午还一个人自由；而一个社会改掉它的习惯，要慢得多。

c: a driver's license 驾照
grant a license 颁发执照
license sth 准许…
poetic license 诗的破格
words.dif: license 是美式拼写，licence 是英式拼写（名词）；动词英美都用 license。与 leash（皮带）无关
words.pat: A license is permission to practise; it is not a promise that the practice will be good.
words.patZh: 执照是执业许可，并不保证执业水平。

c: be innocent of 无罪于…
an innocent bystander 无辜的路人
innocent pleasure 无害的乐趣
plead innocent 作无罪辩护
words.dif: innocent 兼「无罪的」与「天真的」两义；naive 只有「天真」，且带贬义
words.pat: It is the mark of a just system that it can correct the conviction of the innocent without calling it a scandal.
words.patZh: 一个正义制度的标志，是它纠正对无辜者的错判时，不必把这称作丑闻。

c: technological innovation 技术创新
encourage innovation 鼓励创新
an innovation in teaching 教学上的革新
stifle innovation 扼杀创新
words.dif: innovation 强调「引入新方法并带来实效」；invention 只强调「发明出新东西」，未必被采用
words.pat: The most useful innovation in any old institution is usually the honest review of its old files.
words.patZh: 任何老机构最有用的革新，往往是对其旧档案的一次诚实复查。

c: in anguish 在极度痛苦中
mental anguish 精神痛苦
the anguish of waiting 等待的煎熬
anguish over sth 为…而痛苦
words.dif: anguish 指「深沉的、常无法言说的痛苦」；annoyance 只是「烦恼」，程度轻得多
words.pat: Bureaucracy converts the anguish of individuals into the delay of procedures.
words.patZh: 官僚体系把个人的极度痛苦，换算成了程序上的拖延。

c: be annoyed with sb 生某人的气
be annoyed at / by sth 因某事恼火
annoy sb into doing 烦得某人只好做
much to one's annoyance 令某人大为不快的是
words.dif: annoy 是「使不快」，程度中等；irritate 更强烈，且常指持续刺激
words.pat: What annoyed the officials was not the letter itself but the fact that it kept arriving.
words.patZh: 惹恼官员的不是那封信本身，而是它年复一年地寄到。

words.exam: 每年的；年度的；一年一次的
c: an annual report 年度报告
annual income 年收入
annual leave 年假
an annual event 一年一度的事
words.dif: annual 更正式，用于报告、会议等正式场合；yearly 更口语。anniversary（周年）同源易混
words.pat: An annual report that reads like a victory speech deserves to be audited like a claim.
words.patZh: 读起来像祝捷演说词的年报，就该按一条待核的声明来审计。

c: cast anchor 抛锚
anchor a program 主持节目
the anchor of the family 全家的主心骨
be anchored in 扎根于…
words.dif: anchor 作「主持人」是美式新闻用语（英式多用 presenter）；作动词「固定、扎根」常考 be anchored in
words.pat: In a media landscape that changes weekly, the anchor's job is to be the one thing that does not move.
words.patZh: 在每周都在变的媒体环境里，主持人的工作，就是当那个唯一不动的东西。
